meaning: Source-derived finite lifecycle controls for explicitly configured Entity and Value Object factories.
oracle: Use independently interpreted authored Rules and typed field recipes. Predict normalization, validator order and failure prefixes, identity preservation, ownership, keys and frozen results without consulting generated output.
coverage: Retain all source nodes. Cover create and reconstruct, Entity transition, every ordered chain of distinct declared extensions including the empty chain, and invalid extension requests. Extension chains are additive and local. Each chain needs at least one source-valid witness; unavailable witnesses or exceeded bounds make the entire factory not_evaluable, never a partial passing factory or an unsatisfiability claim.
search: Reuse deterministic typed witnesses and Rule literal seeds, including extension Rule closures. At most 4096 search attempts per chain, counting duplicate candidates, 16 accepted witnesses and one rejected probe per distinct validator prefix. Enumerate all ordered extension prefixes within 4096 chains and all cases within 4096 per node, 65536 per project and 8 MiB serialized controls. Rule evaluation remains bounded at 65536 visits and depth 64.
observations: Check create/reconstruct traces, ordered validators with bound closure/artifact hashes, fail-fast codes, frozen results/traces/arrays, owned snapshots and components, full typed values, identity/value keys, clone/foreign rejection, fresh equivalent copies, frozen factory extension lists and unchanged base factory. Entity transition rejects unowned previous values before normalization, validates next fields before identity, preserves identity and previous input. Include hostile descriptors, missing fields, malformed nested values and non-coercing invalid extension requests.
execution: Use only explicit generated factories and their pure Rule/native dependency closure in the existing private permission-restricted observer. No Operations, Workflows, providers, stores or target writes. Bound Rule use does not claim standalone Rule adapter completion.
compatibility: Add one source pin preserving all 46 predecessor pins. No changes to product contracts, generators, default profiles, SFOL, AlchLang, ordered/unordered semantics or production authority.
